mapper.sql: SELECT POST_ID, POST_BOARD_ID, POST_USER_ID_NUMBER, POST_TITLE, POST_CONTENT, POST_CREATED_AT FROM POSTS
mapper.select: WHERE POST_BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY POST_ID DESC
WHERE POST_USER_ID_NUMBER = #{userIdNumber} ORDER BY POST_ID DESC
WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY POST_ID DESC
